name: Garmin
short_desc: External: connect Garmin so Health and your agent get Body Battery, sleep, HRV, heart rate and activity (read-only). Needs a free personal API key from Garmin Connect.
author: Humanity Labs
description: Connect your Garmin with a guided setup inside the app. What you need: a free Garmin Connect account and a personal API key you create yourself on Garmin Connect's Personal API Key page (Garmin's self-serve Personal API for your own data: no developer account, approval or fee). You paste the key once; it lasts 30 days to a year, as you choose, and then you paste a new one. The app keeps a private synced copy and offers it read-only to other apps on this box through the health-data contract; the Health app shows Body Battery at wake as recovery, sleep score and stages, HRV, resting heart rate and intensity minutes. The key stays in the app.
